title: eat shit & die 144
author: bpatrick
html: I kinda fell down the rabbit hole with school there for a little bit — but things are (more or less) back to normal and akimbo comes back with a new Onan! Yay! There’s a new Vivian later in the week (Monday or Tuesday) and we’ll see what I can do for the rest of the week.
